chatFriends_createMenuButtonSubtitle.en: Find people by LOOP ID or nickname and send a message request
chatFriends_createMenuButtonSubtitle.zh: 按 LOOP ID 或昵称找人，发送消息请求

chatFriends_createMenuButtonSubtitle2.en: Apply to list; goes live after review
chatFriends_createMenuButtonSubtitle2.zh: 提交入驻申请，审核通过后上线

chatFriends_createMenuButtonSubtitle3.en: Start a small group with friends

chatFriends_createMenuButtonSubtitle4.en: Scan a profile card, community code or wallet address
chatFriends_createMenuButtonSubtitle4.zh: 扫名片、社区码或钱包地址

chatFriends_screensAlreadyDecided.en: This friend request was already handled. Refresh the list.
chatFriends_screensAlreadyDecided.zh: 这条好友申请已经处理，请刷新列表。

chatFriends_screensBody.en: {name} · {receipt, plural, =1{1 member} other{{receipt} members}}. This result exists only in this run; no Stream channel was created.
chatFriends_screensBody.zh: {name} · {receipt} 位成员。这个结果仅存在于本次运行，未创建 Stream 频道。

chatFriends_screensBody2.en: {name} · {receipt, plural, =1{1 member} other{{receipt} members}}. The channel was created and authorized by the LOOP backend.
chatFriends_screensBody2.zh: {name} · {receipt} 位成员。频道已由 LOOP 后端创建并授权。

chatFriends_screensConflict.en: The friendship changed. Refresh and try again.
chatFriends_screensConflict.zh: 好友关系已经变化，请刷新后再试。

chatFriends_screensCooldown.en: This friend request is cooling down. Try again later.
chatFriends_screensCooldown.zh: 该好友申请处于冷却期，请稍后再试。

chatFriends_screensCursorInvalid.en: The list page expired; reload from the first page.
chatFriends_screensCursorInvalid.zh: 列表分页已过期，需要从第一页重新加载。

chatFriends_screensFriendGroupCreateFail.en: {friendFailureMessage} The draft is frozen and won't be resubmitted automatically.
chatFriends_screensFriendGroupCreateFail.zh: {friendFailureMessage} 当前草稿已冻结，不会自动重复提交。

chatFriends_screensFriendGroupFolioCapti.en: Pick from accepted friends. The LOOP backend creates the group; it only appears in Chat once that succeeds.
chatFriends_screensFriendGroupFolioCapti.zh: 从已接受的好友里选人。群由 LOOP 后端创建，成功后才会出现在聊天里。

chatFriends_screensFriendGroupFriendsEmp.en: You can invite someone to a group after they accept your friend request.
chatFriends_screensFriendGroupFriendsEmp.zh: 好友请求被对方接受后，才能邀请对方创建群组。

chatFriends_screensFriendGroupFriendsFai.zh: 好友列表暂时无法加载

chatFriends_screensFriendGroupUnavailabl.en: No group is created and no members are added here.
chatFriends_screensFriendGroupUnavailabl.zh: 这里不会创建任何群或添加成员。

chatFriends_screensFriendGroupUnavailabl.en: Group chat creation isn't available yet

chatFriends_screensFriendPreviewBannerBo.en: Friends, requests and new groups are kept in memory only and aren't written to the LOOP backend or Stream.
chatFriends_screensFriendPreviewBannerBo.zh: 好友、请求与新群组只保存在内存中，不会写入 LOOP 后端或 Stream。

chatFriends_screensFriendPreviewBannerTi.zh: 开发预览 · 仅本次运行

chatFriends_screensIncomingRequestPendin.en: They've already sent you a request. Handle it in friend requests.
chatFriends_screensIncomingRequestPendin.zh: 对方已经向你发送申请，请在好友申请中处理。

chatFriends_screensInvalidData.en: The input or server data doesn't meet current safety constraints.
chatFriends_screensInvalidData.zh: 输入或服务返回的数据不符合当前安全约束。

chatFriends_screensNotFound.en: The target isn't available right now. Hidden and nonexistent accounts aren't distinguished.
chatFriends_screensNotFound.zh: 目标当前不可用。不可发现和不存在的账号不会被区分。

chatFriends_screensOperatorRequired.en: The channel needs manual review; a second channel won't be created automatically.
chatFriends_screensOperatorRequired.zh: 频道需要后台人工核对；不会自动创建第二个频道。

chatFriends_screensOutcomeUnknown.en: The request may have been received, but the final result can't be safely confirmed right now.
chatFriends_screensOutcomeUnknown.zh: 请求可能已被接收，当前无法安全确认最终结果。

chatFriends_screensOutgoingRequestPendin.en: Friend request sent, waiting for them to respond.
chatFriends_screensOutgoingRequestPendin.zh: 好友申请已经发送，正在等待对方处理。

chatFriends_screensPermissionDenied.en: This account can't do that. No friendship or group was changed.
chatFriends_screensPermissionDenied.zh: 当前账号无权完成该操作，没有关系或群组被修改。

chatFriends_screensProfileRequired.en: Set your LOOP nickname in Profile first.
chatFriends_screensProfileRequired.zh: 请先在 Profile 中设置 LOOP 主昵称。

chatFriends_screensRateLimited.en: Too many attempts. Try again later.
chatFriends_screensRateLimited.zh: 操作过于频繁，请稍后再试。

chatFriends_screensSwitch.en: Couldn't complete the action right now.

chatFriends_screensText.en: {groupMinimumSelectedFriends, plural, =1{Choose at least 1 friend} other{Choose at least {groupMinimumSelectedFriends} friends}}

chatFriends_screensUnavailable.en: The friend service isn't available right now. No friendship or group was changed.
chatFriends_screensUnavailable.zh: 好友服务当前不可用，没有关系或群组被修改。

chatFriends_screensUnexpected.en: The service couldn't complete the request; no friendship or group was changed.
chatFriends_screensUnexpected.zh: 服务暂时无法完成请求；没有好友关系或群组被修改。
